svg.aria-label: Mosofin proposed favicon — a footed total
svg.title: Mosofin proposed favicon — a footed total
svg.desc: Revision 2. Ink plate in the drafted-sheet identity; the paper check of a tie-out above, and the double underline an accountant draws beneath a total that foots. Replaces the inherited Archify cyan hexagon. Fixes rev 1, where the single rule collided with the check.
